issues.description: The problem statement inconsistently refers to the same method using different names: it instructs to implement get_total_number_of_students() (snake_case) in the task description, while the UML and the solution use getTotalNumberOfStudents() (camelCase). This naming inconsistency can confuse students about the exact method name/signature they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across the problem statement and UML. Replace the snake_case reference get_total_number_of_students() in the task text with the camelCase getTotalNumberOfStudents(), and ensure all example code and descriptions use the same camelCase name.
